title: When I was little
can: Describe how things used to be with the imperfecto: vivía, era, había.
doneText: You can now talk about your childhood and how things used to be, and choose between iba and fui.

skills.imp-er: Used to, for -er and -ir: tenía, vivía
skills.imp-odd: Era and iba: the odd ones
skills.imp-or-pret: Used to or did once: iba or fui

discover.intro: All six sentences are in the past. Look at what kind of past each colour describes.

groups.label: Again and again, or how things were
lines: Todos los veranos íbamos a la playa.
Every summer we used to go to the beach.
De pequeñ{o} vivía en un pueblo.
When I was little, I lived in a village.
Mi abuela siempre cocinaba los domingos.
My grandmother always cooked on Sundays.

groups.label: Once, and finished
lines: El verano pasado fuimos a la playa.
Last summer we went to the beach.
El domingo mi abuela cocinó una paella.
On Sunday my grandmother cooked a paella.

discover.question: When does Spanish use the blue forms (íbamos, vivía, cocinaba)?
options: For what used to happen again and again, or how things were.
For one finished event on a known day.
discover.nudge: Not quite. Look at the time words: todos los veranos, de pequeño, siempre. Then el verano pasado, el domingo.
discover.reveal: This is the imperfecto, for what used to happen and how things were. -ar verbs take -aba, -er and -ir verbs take -ía:

hooks.title: The endings
rows: I used to talk a lot.
I used to walk to school.

hooks.title: Words that call for it
rows: De pequeñ{o} jugaba en la calle.
When I was little I played in the street.
Todos los veranos iba al pueblo.
Every summer I went to the village.
A menudo veía a mis primos.

learn.title: How things used to be
learn.sub: Tap any row to hear it

blocks.text: Yo and él or ella share a form: hablaba, vivía. Add yo or a name when it isn't clear who: yo vivía en Bilbao, Ana vivía en Vigo.
Nosotros of -ar verbs has an accent on the first a: hablábamos, jugábamos. -er and -ir verbs have one on every í: vivía, teníamos.

blocks.title: Useful for the past
rows: I had, I used to have
I used to see, I watched

blocks.title: Iba or fui
a: I used to go to the beach.
blocks.note: Iba: again and again, or the scene. Fui: once, and it's over.

blocks.text: Many people in Spain spent their childhood summers in el pueblo, the family's home village, with grandparents and cousins. ¿Ibas al pueblo en verano? is a very Spanish question.

phrases.es: De pequeñ{o} vivía en un pueblo.
phrases.en: When I was little, I lived in a village.
alts: Cuando era pequeñ{o} vivía en un pueblo.
enAlts: As a child I lived in a village.
When I was a kid I lived in a village.

phrases.es: Todos los veranos íbamos a la playa.
phrases.en: Every summer we used to go to the beach.
enAlts: We went to the beach every summer.
Every summer we went to the beach.

phrases.en: My grandmother used to cook really well.
enAlts: My grandma was a really good cook.

phrases.es: Había un parque al lado de mi casa.
phrases.en: There was a park next to my house.
enAlts: There used to be a park next to my house.
There was a park beside my house.
I used to be very shy.
Where did you use to live?

phrases.en: I used to work in a bank.
enAlts: I worked in a bank before.
Before, I worked in a bank.

exercises.q: De pequeña, Ana ___ al tenis todos los sábados.
exercises.sub: (When she was little, Ana played tennis every Saturday.)
exercises.why: Every Saturday, when she was little, is a habit in the past: jugaba.
Tener, yo, imperfecto: tenía, with an accent on the í.

exercises.prompt: Rapid fire: iba (used to) or fui (once)?

items.blank: Todos los domingos ___ a misa con mi abuela.
items.full: Todos los domingos iba a misa con mi abuela.
items.why: Every Sunday is a habit: iba.

items.full: El domingo pasado fui a misa.
De pequeño iba al colegio andando.
items.why: When I was little, a habit: iba.

items.full: Siempre iba al pueblo en verano.

items.why: One trip, in a finished year: fui.

items.blank: A menudo ___ al cine con mi padre.
items.full: A menudo iba al cine con mi padre.

exercises.say: Había mucha gente en la plaza.
options: There were lots of people in the square.
There are lots of people in the square.
Lots of people are going to the square.
exercises.why: Había: there was or there were. Hay is now.
For what someone was like, use the imperfecto of ser: era.

exercises.prompt: Tap the word that is wrong.
exercises.sentence: Antes mis padres trabajaba en Bilbao.
exercises.fixed: Antes mis padres trabajaban en Bilbao.

exercises.prompt: There was a park next to my house.
exercises.answer: Había un parque al lado de mi casa.
exercises.why: Había works like hay: one word for there was and there were.

pairs: I was, it was (what it was like)
I had, I used to have

exercises.q: I used to work in a bank.
exercises.why: Used to work: trabajaba. Antes (before) is often added.

exercises.q: Nosotros ___ al pueblo todos los veranos.
exercises.sub: (We used to go to the village every summer.)
exercises.why: Every summer is a habit: íbamos, with an accent.

exercises.q: When I was little, I lived in Seville.
answer: cuando era pequeño vivía en sevilla
cuando era pequeña vivía en sevilla
cuando era niño vivía en sevilla
cuando era niña vivía en sevilla
exercises.why: De pequeño or cuando era pequeño, then vivía.

exercises.q: En el colegio, nosotros ___ mucho en clase.
exercises.why: Nosotros, -ar: hablábamos, with an accent on the first á.

exercises.prompt: Tap the word that is wrong.
exercises.sentence: Cuando era pequeño, tení un gato.
exercises.fixed: Cuando era pequeño, tenía un gato.

exercises.why: Había for there were. Gente is singular in Spanish: mucha gente.

options: Siempre comíamos en casa de mi abuela.
Ayer comimos en casa de mi abuela.
Hoy hemos comido en casa de mi abuela.
exercises.why: Siempre, again and again: comíamos. Ayer is once: comimos. Hoy: hemos comido.

write.title: Say it in your own words
write.task: Write about where you grew up: where you lived, what it was like, and one thing you used to do every summer.
write.starter: De pequeñ{o} vivía…  Era…  Había…  Todos los veranos…
write.model: De pequeñ{o} vivía en un pueblo cerca del mar. Era un sitio tranquilo y había un parque al lado de mi casa. Todos los veranos íbamos a la playa con mis abuelos.
checklist: -aba and -ía for what used to happen: vivía, íbamos
Era for what a place or person was like

boss.title: Old photos in Asturias
boss.persona: You are Carmen, a warm grandmother of 80 in a village in Asturias, showing the learner (a friend of your grandson) old family photos. Ask about the learner's childhood: where they lived, what it was like, what they did in summer and what they were like as a child. Use tú. Speak European Spanish, mostly in the imperfecto.

turns.npc: Mira, esta era mi casa. ¿Y tú dónde vivías de pequeñ{o}?
turns.en: Look, this was my house. And where did you live when you were little?
choices: Vivía en una ciudad pequeña.
Viví en una ciudad pequeña.
For how things were when you were little, use the imperfecto: vivía.
Vivo en una ciudad pequeña.
Vivo is now. When you were little: vivía.
Era tranquila y había muchos parques.
Fue tranquila y había muchos parques.
For what a place was like, use era.
Eras tranquila y había muchos parques.
Eras is you. The city was: era.

turns.en: What did you do in summer?
choices: Iba a la playa con mis primos.
Fui a la playa con mis primos.
Every summer is a habit: iba, not fui.
Iban a la playa con mis primos.
Iban is they. About yourself: iba.

turns.en: And were you a calm child?
choices: No, era muy travies{o}.
No, fui muy travies{o}.
For what you were like as a child, use era.
No, eras muy travies{o}.
Eras is you. About yourself: era.

boss.closing: ¡Como mi nieto! Siempre se subía a los árboles.
boss.closingEn: Just like my grandson! He was always climbing trees.
boss.chatOpeningEn: And what did you eat when you were little?
